events.event: Promoter Shoemaker Live says Andrea Bocelli's Indonesia concerts will go ahead (Borobudur 31 Oct, JIExpo Kemayoran Jakarta 3 Nov) despite MUI calling for cancellation over his alleged ties to Israel.
events.key_numbers: Borobudur 31 Oct 2026 · Jakarta JIExpo 3 Nov 2026 · 100,000 pairs of shoes pledged for children in Palestine and other war zones · CNBC headline of 14 Oct reported the Borobudur permit as revoked (unresolved)
events.why_it_matters: A religion-and-politics row over a concert that happens in the next few days, with Borobudur's status as a heritage site also in play.
events.spreading_evidence: Antara terpopuler #3 (23 hours old) plus Antara Pilihan Editor HMI piece; several outlets (CNBC, Liputan6, Tirto, Sindonews)

events.event: Bareskrim Polri announced it has named 245 individuals and 20 corporations suspects in the 2026 forest-and-land-fire (karhutla) cases.
events.key_numbers: 245 individual suspects · 20 corporate suspects · about 35,028 ha burned in these cases (5,859.12 ha individuals + 29,168.78 ha corporations; my sum) · most reports: Kalbar 68, Riau 59, Kalteng 43
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether the government is going after the companies behind the haze that grounded flights and sickened residents, not just small farmers.

events.event: BNPB says 462 ha are still burning across 10 provinces (East Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Maluku and others) while it stopped reporting the six priority Sumatra/Kalimantan provinces for lack of new fire data; weather modification continues.
events.key_numbers: 462 ha in 10 provinces as of 29 Oct 07:00 WIB (province rows sum to 434 ha) · East Kalimantan 169 ha · Central Sulawesi 85 ha · Papua Selatan 65 hotspots (28 Oct) · 59 aircraft on standby · 22,600 kg dry ice and NaCl seeded · 2,236 disasters in 2026
events.why_it_matters: The haze season looks to be ending as rains arrive, but fires have shifted to eastern Indonesia.

events.event: A forest police officer (polisi hutan) died after a tree fell on him while fighting a forest fire in North Toraja (Sulawesi Selatan).
events.key_numbers: 1 fatality · KPH Saddang II officer · North Toraja, South Sulawesi
events.why_it_matters: Another firefighter death in the season after four died at Bromo on 15 Oct.

events.event: Heavy rain caused floods and landslides in nine regencies/cities of North Sumatra, with Medan evacuees sheltering in mosques; floods also reported in South Aceh and Kalsel as the rainy transition begins.
events.key_numbers: 9 regencies/cities in Sumut · 603 evacuees in Medan · Medan water 20-150 cm · Sei Putih embankment breach 5 m · no deaths reported in the article · Kalsel floods and puting beliung same day
events.why_it_matters: Regions that burned a month ago now flood, and Jakarta is preparing for the same rainy season.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia Nasional latest feed #1; detik most-read has Gayo Lues M4.3 quake

events.event: Police named Dwi Bagus a suspect for allegedly killing his unregistered wife Dini Hardiyanti and her 4-year-old child, burning and grinding the bodies; he had helped the family report them missing and hid 12 days in Jombang before arrest.
events.key_numbers: 2 victims (Dini Hardiyanti, 30, and her 4-year-old child) · 12 days hiding in Jombang · taken to Polda Jatim 25 Oct · police: possibly one accomplice, under investigation
events.why_it_matters: Viral crime story, but a named private individual and graphic details; low fit for an explainer account.

events.event: A group calling itself Pejuang Merah Putih Indonesia delivered letters to Jokowi's Solo home demanding that he press Vice President Gibran to resign, citing the diploma dispute.
events.key_numbers: a dozen-plus people · 2 letters · warned of impeachment if Gibran does not resign · no Jokowi response yet
events.why_it_matters: Pressure on Gibran is spreading from the MK finding and DPR factions to street groups.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia latest feed; multiple outlets (Fajar, Gelora, Suara Karya)

events.event: Coordinating Minister Yusril said the government will reformulate Articles 2 and 3 of the Tipikor Law to align the corruption definition with UNCAC while keeping the state-loss element; the revision is not yet in the Prolegnas.
events.key_numbers: Articles 2 and 3 of Law 31/1999 (amended by Law 20/2001) · UNCAC ratified 2006 · Prabowo approved DEN study 20 Oct · not yet in Prolegnas
events.why_it_matters: A narrower corruption definition could change which cases KPK and Kejagung can prosecute.

events.event: KPK questioned the Summarecon boss on the bribery flow tied to HGB (building-rights) permits at the Bogor land office, searched Kudus locations beyond PT Djarum in the Bea Cukai case, and questioned DPRD member Vinna Ledy on alleged car and apartment gratification.
events.key_numbers: detik most-read #10, #11, #14, #20 · KPK probing a project received by the wife of a former BNPB head's brother from disaster funds
events.why_it_matters: KPK is working several cases at once; the Djarum search is the most recognisable name.

events.event: PSSI chair Erick Thohir again raised point deductions for clubs after supporter riots in Super League, following an incident involving Persib fans.
events.why_it_matters: A threat that could change league standings, but off-brand for a business/politics account.
